Sɩd la hakɩɩka Wẽnd wʋma pag ning sẽn wẽed foom no-koeemdã a sɩdã wɛɛngẽ wã koɛɛga, la a kʋmd ne Wẽndã. Wẽnd wʋmda yãmb y yiibã tak-n-taarã, ad Wẽnd yaa Wʋmd n yaa Neta.

Neb nins sẽn wõnesd b pagbã ne b ma-rãmbã yãmb pʋgẽ wã, b pa bãmb ma-rãmb ye, bãmb ma-rãmbã pa yɩ, rẽnda sẽn rog-b bãmbã. La ad bãmb yeta gomd sẽn kisi, la zĩri-beedo, la Wẽnd yaa bas-tɩ-loog Soab n yaa Yaafda.

La neb nins sẽn wõnesd p pagbã ne b ma-rãmbã, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b rat n lebs b noyã poorẽ, bɩ a bas yamb bukĩnd taoor tɩ b na n pa sɩɩs taab ye, woto la b sagl yãmba, la Wẽnd yaa kiba-Mit ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

La ned ning sẽn pa paam-a, kiuug a yiib no-loeer sẽn tũnug taab n rog a zugu, taoor tɩ b na n pa sɩɩs taab ye. Ned ning sẽn pa tõe, yaa miskɩɩmb pis-yoob rɩlgr n be ne-a; woto tɩ y na kõ sɩd ne Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã yĩnga. Wãnde yaa Wẽnd todse, la be ne kɩfr-dãmbã naong sẽn zabde.

Neb nins sẽn maand Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã beemã, A ning-b-la yãnd wala b sẽn da ning neb nins sẽn da reng bãmbã yãndã. La sɩd la hakɩɩka, Tõnd sika Aaya-rãmb sẽn yaa vẽenese, la be ne kɩfr-dãmbã faagr naongo.
Raar ning Wẽnd sẽn na yikd bãmb b gill n kõ-b kibar ne bũmb ning b sẽn da tʋmã, Wẽnd tigim-a lame, tɩ bãmb yaool n yĩm-a, Wẽnd yaa Seet ne bãmb fãa gilli.

Rẽ yĩnga fo pa yã tɩ Wẽnde, A mii bũmb ning sẽn be saasẽ la sẽn be Tẽngẽ. Neb a tãab pa yɩ sẽn na yẽse, rẽndame tɩ Yẽnda la b naas Soaba, pa nu me, rẽndame tɩ Yẽ la yoob Soaba, pa sẽn paood n pa ta rẽ me, pa sẽn yɩɩd rẽ me, rẽndame tɩ Yẽ lagem-b lame b sẽn beẽ fãa, rẽ poorẽ t'A kõ-b kibar ne bũmb ning b sẽn tʋme, Dũni wã yikr raare, ad Wẽnd yaa bũmbã fãa gill Mita.

Rẽ yĩnga fo pa yã neb nins b sẽn gɩdg-b n yi wũnusã, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b maand b sẽn gɩdg-b n yi a soabã, la b yẽsd taab ne beegr la beem la Tẽn-tʋʋmã kɩɩsgo, la b sã n wa fo nengẽ, b pʋʋsda foom ne bũmb ning Wẽnd sẽn pa pʋʋs foo ne-a, la b yet b sũy wã: "bõe tɩ Wẽnd pa sɩbgd tõnd ne bũmb ning tõnd sẽn yetã?" Gεhanam na sεk-ba! B kẽed-a lame, la baasg yɩ wẽnga.

Ad vũn-vũnɑ yaa sẽn yi a Sʋɩtãan nengẽ, sẽn na yɩl n sãam neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩdã sũuri, la a ka yɩ sẽn na nams fʋɩ sã n pa ne Wẽnd raabo, bɩ muumin rãmb boblg b mens ne Wẽnde.

Yãmb ɑ neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! B sã n yeel yãmb tɩ y sers zĩisẽ wã, bɩ y serge tɩ Wẽnd na yalg y yĩnga, la b sã n yeel tɩ y yiki, bɩ y yiki, tɩ Wẽnd zẽkda neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã yãmb pʋgẽ la neb nins b sẽn kõ bãngrã dargε-rãmba, la Wẽnd yaa kiba-Mita.
Neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! Yãmb sã n na n yẽs ne Tẽn-tʋʋmã, bɩ y lʋɩɩs yãmb yẽsgã taoor ne sãrã, rẽnda la sõama ne yãmba n le yɩɩd yɩlgre, la yãmb sã n pa paame, ad Wẽnd yaa Yaafd n yaa Yolsda.

Yãmb yaeesda (talemdo) tɩ yãmb sã n lʋɩɩs sãrã-rãmbã y yẽsgã taoore, la yãmb sã n pa maane, tɩ Wẽnd reeg yãmb tuubgu bɩ y yãnes ne Pʋʋsg la y kõ Zaka, la y tũ Wẽnd ne A Tẽn-tʋʋmã. Wẽnd yaa kiba-Mit ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Rẽ yĩnga fo pa yã neb nins sẽn lall neb Wẽnd sẽn gẽ-b rãmba? B pa yɩ n be ne yãmba, b pa be ne bãmb me, n yaool n wẽen zĩri zug tɩ bãmb yaool n miẽ.
Wẽnd segla b yĩnga naong sẽn keeme, ad bãmbã sẽn da tʋmd bũmb ningã yɩ wẽnga.
B rɩka b wẽenegã tɩ yaa gãng ne-ba, tɩ b gɩt n yi Wẽnd sorã, rẽnd faagr naong be ne-ba.
B arzεk kõn n tol n naf-ba, pa b koamb me, n yi Wẽnd baa fʋɩ. Bãmbã la Bugum koamba, bãmb yaa Duumdb a pʋgẽ.
Raar ning Wẽnd sẽn yikd bãmb gilli, tɩ b wẽen ne-A wala b sẽn wẽen ne yãmbã, n tẽed tɩ bãmb bee sɩd zugu, pa bãmb bal la zĩri-be-neba?
A Sʋɩtãan n wil bãmba, n yĩms-b Wẽndã yʋʋr tẽegre. bãmb la a Sʋɩtãan zãma wã, pa a Sʋɩtãan zãma wã la bõn rãmb sɩda?.
Neb nins sẽn maan beem ne Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã, bãmb bee nin-yaalsã pʋgẽ.
Wẽnd gʋlsame: "M na wil neer-neere, Maam ne M Tẽn-tʋʋmbã, ad Wẽnd yaa pãng Soaba, n yaa zɩslem Naaba.

Fo pa yãt neba sẽn kõt sɩd ne Wẽnd la Yaoolem raarã, tɩ b baood nonglem ne ned ning sẽn maand beem ne Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã ye; baa tɩ b yɩ n yaa b ba-rãmba, maa b koamba, maa b ma-biisi, maa b buudu. Bãmbã la A gʋls Liimaoongã b sũyẽ wã, la A keng-b ne Sõngr (dɑliil) sẽn yi A nengẽ, la A kẽesd-b arzãn-rãmba tɩ ko-sood zoet b tẽngre, b yaa Duumdba a pʋgẽ, Wẽnd yard be b yĩnga, bãmb me yarda Wẽnde, bãmb la Wẽnd zãma, la pa Wẽnd zãma wã bal la põsdb la?
